guidance_penalty.rationale: Penalizes stocks where management guidance revision is downward and confirmed by intraday sell pressure; TW companies issuing negative guidance after hours typically gap down 2-3% next session
guidance_penalty.todo: Backtest penalty accuracy against TWSE post-guidance-revision return distribution 2022-2026

guidance_threshold.rationale: 1% below session high triggers guidance penalty; TW stocks failing to hold within 99% of highs after guidance events indicate market skepticism about management outlook
guidance_threshold.todo: Calibrate 0.985/0.990/0.995 against TWSE guidance-event intraday range patterns

repeatable_boost.rationale: Strong conviction boost for companies showing 3+ consecutive quarters of positive earnings surprise exceeding analyst consensus; TW firms with repeatable earnings beat patterns sustain momentum for 6-9 months

liquidity_good_delta.rationale: +3 conviction boost for adequate liquidity; modest delta reflecting that good liquidity enables but doesn't generate alpha — it removes a constraint rather than adding edge
liquidity_good_delta.todo: Calibrate 2/3/4: verify marginal benefit of liquidity boost beyond execution-cost reduction

liquidity_good_threshold.rationale: Liquidity score ≥0.2 triggers +3 delta; adequate liquidity for institutional-sized TWSE orders without significant market impact — used by TechnicalBreakout and ETFRotation executors
liquidity_good_threshold.todo: Calibrate 0.15/0.20/0.30 against TWSE institutional order market-impact models

liquidity_high_delta.rationale: +5 conviction boost for high liquidity; slightly higher than standard moderate delta (+4) because liquidity directly reduces execution costs, providing a tangible alpha enhancement
liquidity_high_delta.todo: Calibrate 4/5/6: measure alpha contribution of liquidity boost vs execution-cost savings

liquidity_high_threshold.rationale: Liquidity score ≥0.5 triggers +5 delta; identifies highly liquid TWSE stocks (top quartile turnover, tight spreads) where execution risk is minimal — used by TechnicalBreakout for volume-confirmed entries
liquidity_high_threshold.todo: Calibrate 0.4/0.5/0.6 against liquidity-quartile execution slippage and fill-rate data

liquidity_low_delta.rationale: -5 conviction penalty for insufficient liquidity; magnitude reflects that poor liquidity can turn a good signal into a losing trade through slippage, making it a first-order risk factor
liquidity_low_delta.todo: Calibrate -6/-5/-4: validate penalty magnitude against actual TWSE slippage costs in low-liquidity regime

liquidity_low_threshold.rationale: Liquidity score ≤-0.3 triggers -5 penalty; identifies stocks where bid-ask spreads and turnover indicate prohibitive execution costs (>50bp estimated slippage) for institutional positions
liquidity_low_threshold.todo: Calibrate -0.35/-0.30/-0.20 against TWSE low-liquidity stock execution-cost and fill-failure data

momentum_high_delta.rationale: +8 conviction boost for strong momentum (>0.4); magnitude reflects momentum factor's historical 60-65% hit rate on TWSE mid/large-cap universe over 20-day forward window
momentum_high_delta.todo: Calibrate 6/8/10: measure hit-rate uplift per delta increment on backtest

momentum_high_threshold.rationale: Momentum factor score ≥0.4 triggers high-conviction delta (+8); top 20% of TWSE momentum distribution, used by TechnicalBreakout for breakout-confirmed momentum picks
momentum_high_threshold.todo: Calibrate 0.3/0.4/0.5 against TWSE momentum-quintile forward returns; higher threshold increases selectivity

momentum_mod_delta.rationale: +4 conviction boost for moderate momentum; conservative half-weighting relative to high tier reflects lower signal strength at median momentum levels where noise increases
momentum_mod_delta.todo: Calibrate 3/4/5: verify linearity of delta-to-forward-return relationship

momentum_mod_threshold.rationale: Momentum score ≥0.15 triggers moderate delta (+4); captures above-median momentum stocks (40th-80th percentile), used by TechnicalBreakout for standard picks and Shipping for BDI-cycle entries
momentum_mod_threshold.todo: Calibrate 0.10/0.15/0.20 against TWSE momentum moderate-tier hit rate and false-positive rate

momentum_weak_delta.rationale: -4 conviction penalty for weak/negative momentum; symmetric to moderate delta (+4) reflecting equal conviction adjustment magnitude in both directions
momentum_weak_delta.todo: Calibrate -5/-4/-3: validate symmetry assumption against TWSE bear-regime momentum patterns

momentum_weak_threshold.rationale: Momentum score ≤-0.1 triggers penalty (-4); identifies negative-momentum TWSE stocks where trend has reversed, protecting against value-trap entries in declining names
momentum_weak_threshold.todo: Calibrate -0.15/-0.10/-0.05: compare penalty-hit rate against subsequent drawdown severity

quality_delta.rationale: +4 conviction boost for quality; matches moderate-tier delta convention across all factors, ensuring uniform factor-weight contribution scaling
quality_delta.todo: Calibrate 3/4/5: validate hit-rate improvement per delta increment in quality-sorted TWSE backtest

quality_threshold.rationale: Quality factor score ≥0.2 triggers +4 delta; captures firms with strong ROE, low accruals, and stable margins — used by ValueYield, EarningsQuality, and Financials executors
quality_threshold.todo: Calibrate 0.15/0.20/0.30 against quality-quintile forward returns on TWSE; higher threshold increases purity

value_high_delta.rationale: +8 conviction boost for deep value (>0.3); TW value premium averages 3-5% annual excess return in top value quintile, warranting conviction proportional to momentum boost
value_high_delta.todo: Calibrate 6/8/10: measure hit-rate uplift and alpha contribution per delta increment

value_high_threshold.rationale: Value factor score ≥0.3 triggers high-conviction delta (+8); captured by ValueYield executor for deep-value picks with strong P/B and P/E discounts on TWSE
value_high_threshold.todo: Calibrate 0.25/0.30/0.40 against TWSE value-quintile forward returns and value-premium persistence

value_mod_delta.rationale: +4 conviction boost for moderate value; consistent with momentum moderate delta, maintaining factor-weight symmetry across the multi-factor scoring framework

value_mod_threshold.rationale: Value score ≥0.1 triggers moderate delta (+4); above-median value used by Financials (bank valuations) and ValueYield (broad value screening) for moderate conviction

credit_quality_boost.rationale: Small boost for credit-quality-gate financials with positive intraday price action; conservative magnitude reflects noisy credit-quality signal in short-term price data

reject_low_volume_floor.rationale: Hard rejection threshold at 5M shares for breakout candidates with 'reject low volume' prompt; prevents low-liquidity TWSE names from entering the pipeline when structure-first filtering is required
reject_low_volume_floor.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) to calibrate false-breakout rejection rate

relaxed_volume_floor.rationale: Coverage expansion regime disables volume floor (zero) to permit scanning mid-cap and small-cap TWSE names that exhibit breakout structure but trade below standard liquidity thresholds
relaxed_volume_floor.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) to assess expansion quality

strict_volume_floor.rationale: Surge-signal validation requires 40% higher volume than default (7M vs 5M) to confirm genuine institutional buying pressure on TWSE, avoiding false breakouts from retail momentum traps
strict_volume_floor.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) to optimize surge floor

surge_boost.rationale: +4 conviction boost when volume meets the strict surge floor (7M+); confirms that TWSE breakout is backed by abnormally high participation, signaling strong institutional conviction in the move
surge_boost.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) across 3/4/5 values

surge_penalty.rationale: -4 conviction penalty when volume fails to meet strict surge floor despite surge requirement; flags TWSE breakouts that lack the expected institutional volume, indicating potential bull trap
surge_penalty.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) to calibrate false-surge penalty

volume_boost.rationale: +8 conviction boost when volume meets the 5M default floor and prompt requests volume confirmation; rewards TWSE breakouts backed by sufficient participation, distinguishing genuine institutional interest from noise
volume_boost.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) across 6/8/10 values

cash_flow_boost.rationale: High conviction boost for free-cash-flow yield signal confirmed by intraday price strength; TW value stocks with FCF yield > 8% and positive price confirmation show 12-18% annual outperformance historically
cash_flow_boost.todo: Backtest against TWSE FCF-yield sorted quintile returns 2020-2026 to validate boost magnitude

yield_trap_penalty.rationale: Penalizes suspiciously high dividend yield (>8%) when accompanied by negative intraday price action; flags potential yield traps where high yield masks deteriorating fundamentals in TW cyclical names
yield_trap_penalty.todo: Calibrate 8/10/12 against TWSE high-yield trap false-positive rate using forward-return analysis

correlation_threshold.rationale: 70% correlation is high and warrants penalty

default_atr.rationale: Non-zero default for ATR-based position sizing (2% of price as fallback)

default_payoff_ratio.todo: Should be overridden by agent historical stats

default_win_rate.todo: Should be overridden by agent historical stats

kelly_fraction.rationale: Half-Kelly (0.5) per Thorp (2006) — balances growth and drawdown under parameter uncertainty.

max_drawdown_limit.rationale: 15% max drawdown limit (professional fund risk controls: 15-25% range)

confidence_threshold.rationale: Minimum of 3 supporting signals or confidence points required for inclusion

d6_expiry_trading_days.rationale: Unselected Layer-2 candidates remain on the D6 watchlist for 60 trading days before expiry

drawdown_threshold.rationale: 30% drawdown threshold for risk flag (flag only, not exclusion)

factor_score_max_age_days.rationale: Factor scores older than 30 days are downgraded to avoid stale inputs

foreign_flow_weight.rationale: Oracle-calibrated new foreign-investor flow factor; core driver for Taiwan equities

max_industry_concentration.rationale: Oracle-recommended 40% cap to avoid semiconductor over-concentration in the universe

min_daily_amount_twd.rationale: Relaxed Layer-2.5 re-check floor of NT$5M for liquidity verification before final inclusion

momentum_weight.rationale: Oracle-calibrated weight reduced sharply from 0.30 to 0.15 because Taiwan momentum reverses quickly

pb_weight.rationale: Oracle-calibrated weight for book-value factor; important for financials screening

pe_weight.rationale: Oracle-calibrated weight for valuation factor; retained despite Taiwan PE distortion from semiconductors

price_minimum.rationale: Minimum stock price of NT$10 for universe eligibility

quality_weight.rationale: Oracle-calibrated weight combining ROE, ROA and accruals quality

supply_chain_expand_depth.rationale: Expand supply-chain mapping up to 2 hops when building representative stock sets

top_n.rationale: Default universe size of 150 names; Oracle recommends 120-180 dynamic range, with bear-market override to 100-120

var_contribution_multiplier.rationale: Exclude names with VaR contribution above 2x the portfolio average

volatility_multiplier.rationale: Exclude names with 30-day realized volatility above 2x the median

volume_floor_twd.rationale: Minimum daily turnover of NT$10M replaces share-count floor to avoid low-priced stocks passing a 100-lot screen

volume_weight.rationale: Oracle-calibrated weight reduced from 0.20 to 0.15 to make room for the foreign-flow factor

min_samples.rationale: Minimum samples for eligible calibration status; mirrors capitalflow 30-sample gate (forces.go H-CF-02). Below this the point estimate is not displayed.

threshold.rationale: Cumulative foreign net buy over the window must exceed this value to trigger (PR 2a).

window_days.rationale: Foreign net-buy accumulation window in trading days (PR 1c demo condition; configurable since PR 2a).
window_days.todo: Calibrate: tune window against backtest win rates once OOS samples accumulate.

threshold.rationale: Momentum must exceed this value to trigger (PR 2a).

window_days.rationale: Momentum lookback in trading days: close[t]/close[t-window] - 1 (PR 1c demo condition; configurable since PR 2a).
window_days.todo: Calibrate: tune window against backtest win rates once OOS samples accumulate.

round_trip_pct.rationale: Taiwan round-trip cost: commission 0.1425% ×2 + sell-side transaction tax 0.3% ≈ 0.585%. NetHit uses this to avoid systematically overstating win rates (k3 review R1 / P0-3).
round_trip_pct.todo: Calibrate: after backtest aggregation produces enough samples, fit per-window cost from slippage/impact data.

layers.rationale: foreign-3d-net-buy enforces the full two-level gate: per-symbol foreign magnitude + both market-regime layers (PR 2b).

momentum-20d-positive is a price condition; its gate narrows to the two institution-driven layers (per-symbol foreign + institutional market regime) and skips the retail regime (PR 2b review fix: real narrowing, not a no-op all-three copy).

fail_closed_when_all_missing.rationale: When every enforced gateway layer is skipped due to missing data, fail closed (no-decision): the live path must never trade on a fully-missing flow picture. Backtests may set false to keep evaluating on partial data (PR 2b review fix).

min_abs_net.rationale: Minimum |foreign net buy| of the CHECKED SYMBOL (億股) for the per-symbol foreign layer; ≈1 萬張 net buy on one symbol marks meaningful foreign interest (PR 2b review fix: per-symbol granularity).
min_abs_net.todo: Calibrate: tune per-symbol magnitude against backtest win rates once OOS samples accumulate.

min_abs_raw.rationale: Minimum |investment-trust net buy| (億股, market regime) for the institutional layer; 投信 daily magnitudes are smaller than 外資, so the raw gate is lower (PR 2b). No per-symbol source exists — 市場 regime 參考 only.

min_abs_z.rationale: Minimum |investment-trust z-score| (capitalflow 60-day rolling) for the institutional market-regime layer; 0.5 aligns with capitalflow's bullish/bearish trend boundary.

min_abs_raw.rationale: Minimum |retail composite| (融資+融券/借券 change pct, capitalflow ForceRetail RawValue) for the retail market-regime layer; a >1pct composite move marks meaningful retail positioning (PR 2b).

min_abs_z.rationale: Minimum |retail z-score| for the retail market-regime layer; 0.5 aligns with capitalflow's bullish/bearish trend boundary.

fallback_strategy.rationale: Default strategy when no clear winner; momentum has broad applicability
fallback_strategy.todo: Validate: backtest fallback strategy vs alternatives

min_switch_interval_days.rationale: Minimum days between strategy switches; prevents whipsaw
min_switch_interval_days.todo: Calibrate: test [3, 14] range based on transaction costs

score_lookback_days.rationale: Days of historical performance to evaluate when scoring strategies

switch_threshold.rationale: Minimum score advantage (10%) required to switch strategies

dividend_tax_rate.rationale: Taiwan individual income tax rate on dividend income (28% bracket)

nhi_surcharge_rate.rationale: Taiwan NHI supplementary premium (二代健保補充保費) rate 2.11% effective 2021

transaction_tax_rate.rationale: Taiwan securities transaction tax (0.3%, sell-side only)
